capabilities: Rewrite image paths at render time in reading view and live preview
Retry unresolved relative paths as vault-root paths
disambiguation: Not a general tsconfig or path-alias tool; it only rewrites image paths at render time so embedded images display.
extras: No prebuilt release is documented; users must build the plugin themselves and copy main.js and manifest.json into the plugins folder. Needs a tsconfig.json with compilerOptions.paths at the vault root.
problem: Obsidian cannot resolve @/ style path-alias image links from Astro/Vite projects, so those images show as file-not-found.

relations.evidence: Astro / Vite projects (e.g. Astro Paper) reference images with aliases like ![alt](@/assets/images/example.jpg).

summary: Renders images referenced with tsconfig.json path aliases (@/assets/...) by rewriting those paths at render time in reading view and live preview.
